quotes.text: We additionally report paired score differences (Wilcoxon signed-rank) and two one-sided tests (TOST) for equivalence

parsed.rationale: Tests (Wilcoxon, TOST, Holm correction) are used for the generator-robustness and specialty-context ablations, and physician ranges are given. The headline 10-model comparison in Table 2 has no CI or significance test, and the model-versus-physician comparison is untested.
